user.title: Dashboard Assistant
user.description: Enter the address and API token of your Dashboard Assistant device. The token is shown on the device's Config → Info screen.

zeroconf_confirm.title: Dashboard Assistant
zeroconf_confirm.description: Add {name}? Pair automatically so you don't have to copy the token, or enter it by hand.

pair.title: Pair with {name}
pair.description: Couldn't pair automatically. If this device is already set up, open **Config → Add to HA → Pair** on its screen, then retry. (A brand-new device pairs on its own.)

manual.title: Dashboard Assistant
manual.description: Enter the API token shown on {name}'s Config → Info screen.

reauth_confirm.title: Dashboard Assistant
reauth_confirm.description: The API token was rejected. Enter the current token from the device's Config → Info screen.

error.pairing_closed: The device isn't in pairing mode. On its screen, open Config → Add to HA and press Pair, then try again.

abort.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach the device to identify it — it may still be starting up. It will be rediscovered automatically.
abort.wrong_device: The token belongs to a different Dashboard Assistant device
